answer: Reputation is computed from reciprocity-weighted trust links and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so a node must provide sustained honest service to build durable influence. A fresh Sybil identity starts with negligible incoming trust and near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; splitting activity among aliases does not create support. Without established paths through trusted peers, it cannot meet consensus thresholds, even if it wanders through the network seeking an inlet to the vault.
